lyrics:
[Intro: Juice WRLD & G Herbo]

Back to the studio, back to the dough
[Chorus: Juice WRLD & G Herbo]
I don't trip about it no more, I got used to it (I don't trip)

title: Amuse You (with G Herbo)
author: Juice WRLD & G Herbo
